agent_run_id.description: The `AgentRun` that performed the fetch; also the fact's `citation.origin_uri` (`demiton://agent/portal_fetch/run/{id}`).

content.description: One generated sentence: "Portal document {name} fetched by estimating/portal_fetch (agent run {id})." The searchable prose half.

external_id.description: Identity of the fetched document: `{portal}:{document_id}`. Maps to `Fact.source_id`.

fact_class.description: Provenance class: an agent's metadata capture of a downloaded file, not a value the source system reported.

financial_period.description: Declared `FINANCIAL_PERIOD` axis; resolved from `occurred_at` when the writer passes no coordinate.

name.description: The file name as the portal listed it.

occurred_at.description: The download time, stamped at write; the event key of an episodic fact and the source `FINANCIAL_PERIOD` derives from.

opportunity_ref.description: The opportunity the fetch was for, from the agent goal; a reference, not a resolved entity.

project.description: Declared `PROJECT` axis; populated only when the opportunity resolves to a project.

sha256.description: Content fingerprint of the fetched bytes; the integrity claim about a file whose bytes are not kept.

size_bytes.description: Size of the fetched bytes at download time.

source_portal.description: Which portal the document came from; defaults to the literal `"portal"` when the artifact omits it.

source_system.description: Originating system stamp; the writer hard-codes `"DEMITON"` here.
